name: Nitroflare
description: Resolves Nitroflare links with a premium key, or without one via the free flow.

account.secret_hint: Enter your account e-mail as username and your premium key (My Account → API) as secret.

codes.nitroflare.bad_credentials: Nitroflare premium key is invalid or login failed
codes.nitroflare.captcha_invalid: Nitroflare rejected a captcha response; this plugin cannot solve captchas
codes.nitroflare.captcha_required: Nitroflare requires solving a captcha to continue using the API
codes.nitroflare.free_limit_reached: Nitroflare free download limit reached for this IP address
codes.nitroflare.free_link_host_mismatch: Nitroflare returned a download link on an unexpected host: {host}
codes.nitroflare.no_download_url: Nitroflare did not return a download URL
codes.nitroflare.no_free_link: Nitroflare free download did not yield a file link: {diagnosis}
codes.nitroflare.no_free_markers: Nitroflare free download page was not recognized: {diagnosis}
codes.nitroflare.premium_required: Nitroflare premium account is required to use the download API
codes.nitroflare.rate_limited: Nitroflare API rate limit was triggered
codes.nitroflare.timer_not_started: Nitroflare did not start the pre-download countdown (answer: {answer})
